recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed unless a later PA tracker revises the Encounter and Appointment boundary wording.
issue_request: FHIR-32346 is a Published/Persuasive Patient Administration clarification for FHIR-core Encounter. It asked that the Encounter full definition provide more context than the short definition and approved wording explaining that Encounter records actual healthcare activities while Appointment records planned activities.
initial_application: The source change appears to have been applied by git commit a7b6558e1340c7fd52742c8f80c1b327351d3abd, which updated source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml to append the approved Appointment contrast to the Encounter root definition. No prior Issue-Reconcile-Key: FHIR-32346 commit existed on the combined branch before this reconciliation.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists encounter=Encounter, so source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml is in current build scope. The current source and combined branch both retain the expanded definition. Jira related searches returned only FHIR-32346, Zulip searches found no relevant discussion, and PA Confluence minutes only corroborated the persuasive vote without adding conflicting direction.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because the authoritative Encounter StructureDefinition already satisfies the Jira resolution.
